# 書き起こし.com

> 講演・インタビュー・スピーチの書き起こし記事を共有するサイト

## About

書き起こし.com is a Japanese transcription archive publishing verbatim transcripts of speeches, interviews, and presentations since 2011. All content is in Japanese.

## Content Policy

- Search indexing and excerpts: Allowed
- AI model training and fine-tuning: Not permitted
- Real-time AI search (citations, summaries): Allowed with attribution
- When citing content, attribute to "書き起こし.com" with a link to the source URL

## Contact
